name: Amisaka Aya
source:
A girl who grew up in the same facility as Takaya and Yashiro, who is also a User. She was one of the very few friends of Takaya during his time at the facility. Now, she is a meber of the 3rd Unit, mainly as a mainline combat soldier. Her title is "Dazzle."
She's a flamboyant type of person who mainly utilizes "desu wa" in her speech. She loves Yashiro, very much, although it is unknown if Yashiro shares the same feelings.
